title: AIOS Unit — Guardrail
description: Frontmatter for a guardrails/ policy unit (guardrails/core.md rules, or guardrails/<domain>/ rules). Extends base.schema.json. Guardrails never enter the Stale state and every change requires a full RFC, per guardrails/README.md and governance/README.md.

status.description: Guardrails omit 'Stale' — a guardrail does not go quietly out of date; it changes only through an explicit RFC.

scope.description: 'core' (Tier G, loaded every session) or a domain name (loaded like a Standard when that domain is in scope).

checkpoint.description: Which of Kernel/Guardrails' four checkpoints consult this rule (kernel/guardrails/README.md).

enforcement.description: Whether a hit blocks the action outright or escalates to a human.
